title: sdv-dev/DeepEcho
summary: Mixed-type multivariate time-series generation, implementing the PAR model that backs SDV's PARSynthesizer.

title: sdv-dev/SDMetrics
summary: Vendor-agnostic evaluation library for synthetic data: diagnostic and quality reports, column-wise and pairwise similarity metrics, privacy metrics such as DisclosureProtection, and visualization utilities. The only library in the ecosystem still under an OSI-approved license (MIT).

title: sdv-dev/CTGAN
summary: Reference implementation of CTGAN and TVAE, used both standalone and as the deep-learning backend of SDV's single-table synthesizers.

title: sdv-dev/SDGym
summary: Benchmarking harness that runs synthesizers (SDV's and third-party ones) across public datasets and reports quality, runtime and memory. The substrate for most head-to-head comparisons in the tabular synthesis literature.

title: sdv-dev/Copulas
summary: Multivariate copula models (Gaussian and vine) with univariate marginal fitting. Backs GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, the default statistical model in SDV.

title: sdv-dev/RDT
summary: Reversible Data Transforms: the preprocessing layer that converts arbitrary column types into numeric form for modeling and inverts the transformation afterwards, including anonymization transformers such as AnonymizedFaker and RegexGenerator.

title: sdv-dev/SDV
summary: The main SDV library: single-table, multi-table and sequential synthesizers, metadata, constraints, sampling and evaluation. Business Source License 1.1 since v0.18.0 (MIT through v0.17.2), each release reverting to MIT four years after its own release date. Distributed on PyPI as `sdv` and on conda-forge.

title: sdv-dev/TGAN
summary: The original LSTM-based tabular GAN, superseded by CTGAN and dormant since 2022. Retained under MIT; of historical and citation interest.

title: CA-CTGAN
summary: A command-line implementation of CA-CTGAN, a context-aware conditional tabular GAN for high-fidelity synthesis. The name states the lineage and the code confirms it: the data handler is built on RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, the same mixed-type transform CTGAN uses, with the context-awareness added on top. A derivative of CTGAN's conditional architecture rather than a user of the library.

title: CTGAN on credit card data
summary: A study testing whether CTGAN can generate usable tabular data and improve an imbalanced credit-card dataset. A full copy of the CTGAN repository sits in-tree as `CTGAN-master/`, and the notebook imports `CTGANSynthesizer` from it. The work is entirely an evaluation of CTGAN on one dataset.

title: ClavaDDPM
summary: Official implementation of ClavaDDPM, a cluster-guided diffusion model for multi-relational data synthesis, published at NeurIPS 2024. SDV supplies both the schema layer and a baseline: `MultiTableMetadata` describes the relational structure the model works over, `CTGANSynthesizer` is one of the compared generators, and `ctgan` and `copulas` are pinned. A multi-table method measured against SDV on SDV's own metadata representation.

title: Constrained DGMs
summary: Code for the ICLR 2024 paper proposing a constraint layer that forces deep generative models for tabular data to respect background knowledge. SDV is threaded through the whole evaluation: `sdv.metrics.tabular` supplies the detection metrics, SDMetrics supplies the classifier-based ones, RDT backs the TableGAN transform, and CTGAN is vendored twice as a constrained baseline. The paper's realism claim is measured largely in SDV's units.

title: Customs Fraud Detection (BACUDA)
summary: Material from the World Customs Organization's BACUDA project, applying machine learning to customs fraud detection across member administrations. A dedicated notebook generates synthetic import declarations with `CTGANSynthesizer`, letting administrations share methods without sharing trade data. An intergovernmental use of CTGAN as a data-sharing mechanism.

title: DP-MERF
summary: An implementation of differentially private mean-embedding random features for private data generation. SDGym is the data source rather than a competitor: the tabular experiment loads its benchmark datasets through `sdgym.load_dataset`. SDV's benchmark harness supplies the common ground the private method is measured on.

title: DPSynth
summary: A Google library for differentially private synthetic tabular data generation, taking a set of target queries and producing data that answers them under a privacy budget. SDMetrics is its evaluation dependency, imported in the worked example and declared in the project metadata. SDV supplies the yardstick against which a competing private generator reports quality.

title: Diyago/Tabular-data-generation
summary: GAN-based tabular augmentation project carrying a CTGAN implementation under its research directory.

title: Faruman/Comparison_FinancialDataGeneration
summary: Comparison of generative models for financial transaction data. Runs a patched copy of SDV's installed package alongside the multi-table API, so SDV is both the subject and the harness.

title: FedTabDiff
summary: Implementation of a federated diffusion model for synthetic mixed-type tabular data, distributing training across clients. SDV appears on both sides of the experiment: each federated client builds a `SingleTableMetadata` description, and evaluation uses SDMetrics' `KSComplement` and `TVComplement`, with `ctgan` and `copulas` pinned as baselines. The metadata layer and the column-level metrics are SDV's.

title: Hernan Huwyler risk management

title: OncoGAN

SDV generates the mutation-position distributions: the training notebooks import `CTGANSynthesizer` and `TVAESynthesizer` alongside `SingleTableMetadata` and the local CSV loader, with `sdv==1.4.0` pinned in both the training and simulating environments. A genomics application where the tabular layer is SDV's.

title: PyCaret Streamlit application
summary: An end-to-end machine-learning web application for classification and regression built on the PyCaret AutoML framework. `sdv` is a declared dependency exercised in a test notebook through the pre-1.0 `sdv.tabular.GaussianCopula`. title: PyTorch JIT ParityBench
summary: A test suite measuring TorchScript parity with PyTorch across modules crawled automatically from popular GitHub projects. CTGAN's discriminator and TVAE's encoder appear as generated test cases, harvested from the vendored CTGAN copy inside tab-ddpm rather than from SDV directly. title: STDG evaluation metrics

SDV is one of the generators under evaluation and supplies two of the three arms: notebooks import `from sdv import SDV`, `CTGANSynthesizer` and `GaussianMultivariate` from copulas, with output directories named per generator. SDV is the object of measurement rather than the measuring instrument here.

title: SecureML
summary: A library of utilities for building privacy-preserving machine-learning systems, covering anonymisation, differential privacy and synthesis. SDV is the synthesis backend, declared as an unpinned dependency and driven through `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` in the worked examples, with copulas resolved beneath it. Synthetic generation in this toolkit is SDV wearing a privacy-oriented wrapper.

title: SynMeter
summary: A library for tuning, training and evaluating tabular data synthesis on fidelity, privacy and utility, published at CCS 2025. Its GAN synthesizer reuses RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder` for the mixed-type transform, with `rdt==1.9.1` pinned. SDV's contribution here is the encoding layer rather than a generator.

title: Synth Studio
summary: A product for generating privacy-safe synthetic data and compliance packs, aimed at regulated startups in healthcare and fintech. `CTGANSynthesizer` is the generator behind the service, imported in the backend's generator layer. SDV is the engine a commercial compliance offering is built on.

title: Synthetic data evaluation framework

SDV supplies the metric definitions the framework organises.

title: TableDiffusion

The paper's claim is measured against SDV's generators.

title: TabularFM

The SDV stack is embedded rather than imported: `ctgan` is vendored in-tree with its data transformer still built on RDT's `ClusterBasedNormalizer` and `OneHotEncoder`, while SDMetrics' `QualityReport` scores the output and both are pinned. SDV supplies the encoding and evaluation layers a foundation-model framework is built on top of.

title: sdv.dev - The Synthetic Data Vault project site
summary: Project landing site: library directory, community statistics and download counts, and the blog.

title: DataCebo Forum

title: Learning Vine Copula Models For Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Casts vine copula structure selection as a reinforcement learning problem, learning tree structures that capture hierarchical dependence in tabular data better than greedy heuristics.

title: Modeling Tabular Data using Conditional GAN
summary: Introduces CTGAN and TVAE, together with mode-specific normalization and training-by-sampling to handle imbalanced categorical columns and multi-modal continuous columns. The most cited artifact in the ecosystem and the standard baseline for tabular synthesis.

title: The Synthetic Data Vault
summary: The founding SDV paper. Introduces generative modeling of an entire multi-table relational database via recursive conditional parameter aggregation, and evaluates it by having data scientists solve predictive tasks on synthetic versus real data with no statistically significant difference in outcome.

title: Copula Graphical Models for Wind Resource Estimation

title: CENTS: Generating synthetic electricity consumption time series for rare and unseen scenarios
summary: Generates high-fidelity synthetic household electricity consumption traces, including rare and unobserved scenarios, for power-grid planning and simulation.

title: Sequential Models in the Synthetic Data Vault
summary: Documents the PAR algorithm used for multi-sequence time series in SDV: context columns are modeled separately from the sequence body, allowing generation of new entities with their own coherent sequences.

title: Synthesizing Tabular Data using Generative Adversarial Networks (TGAN)
summary: The first tabular GAN from the group, using an LSTM to generate columns sequentially for mixed discrete and continuous tables. Direct predecessor of CTGAN.

title: Synthetic data assessment based on model improvement
summary: Frameworks for assessing synthetic data quality by measuring whether it improves downstream models, rather than by statistical similarity alone.

title: Synthesizing Tabular Data using Conditional GAN
summary: The thesis version of CTGAN, with a broader benchmark against contemporary tabular generative models; the benchmarking apparatus became SDGym.

title: SDV: An Open Source Library for Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Lays out the software abstractions and architecture for building generative models over database systems, and introduces reversible data transforms (later the RDT library) as the mechanism that makes such modeling tractable.

title: The Synthetic Data Vault: Generative Modeling for Relational Databases
summary: The MEng thesis behind the DSAA paper, developing the first generative modeling technique capable of covering an entire relational database rather than a single flat table.

title: AI and Data Science handbook
